# LokTube 2.1.0

- New branded Windows installer with LokTube's dark navy and ice-blue design, a compact setup screen and an optional installation folder.
- Streamlined in-app updates: Restart and install applies the downloaded update silently and reopens LokTube, without a second confirmation or another setup walkthrough. Existing installation locations and scope are retained.
- Apple Silicon and Intel macOS DMG/ZIP installers are built and checked automatically alongside Windows and Linux releases.
- The download page offers separate Apple Silicon and Intel Mac downloads.

The streamlined updater applies once 2.1.0 is installed; updating from an older version may still use that version's confirmation flow.
